critical_code_review_comments: routes/dining_club.py:239-244 — dining_prefs is upserted BEFORE _require_active_sub / credit check runs. Consequence: even a 400 no_available_credits or 403 no_active_membership call still overwrites the user's last_pref. That's actually the intended behavior for the QuickPlay memory (pref shouldn't require successful start) but worth noting: an anonymous test with a bad meal_period could still upsert bad data. Non-blocking — StartBody Pydantic constrains it to a string; consider tightening meal_period to Literal['LUNCH','DINNER','ANY'].
DiningPlay.jsx:32-40 — home() is called on every mount without an in-flight guard; if the user rapidly navigates in/out you might get stale setLastPref writes. Non-blocking, effect is idempotent.

mobile/app/store/[id].tsx:39-47 — Animated pulse loop runs continuously for the whole screen lifetime even when NO low card exists. Micro perf non-issue on web preview; on native could add unnecessary bridge traffic. Consider starting the loop only when at least one card matches low.
StorePage.jsx:141 + mobile [id].tsx:130 — lowThreshold duplicated; matches web+mobile so parity is preserved. If a third surface appears, extract to shared util.
